summary: Implemented parse_to_datetime (INTERNALDATE and RFC 822 forms, dotted times, weekday-comma fix, normalise handling), datetime_to_native (added because the tests import it), datetime_to_INTERNALDATE and format_criteria_date in imapclient/datetime_util.py. The module's 8 datetime tests pass when run in-process with a harness-only FixedOffset shim, but not through c0-test because fixed_offset.py lacks utcoffset/dst/tzname and util.py lacks assert_imap_protocol, both owned by other builders. Last full-suite run: 18 collection errors, 0 passed, 0 failed.
